title: 第一章 什嘛我亲妈是白狐第二章 起猛了
content_zh:
第一章【什嘛，我亲妈是白狐？】
陈言坐在金陵府高铁站候车大厅里，手里抱着一个双肩包，怔怔的看着候车大厅上的广告牌在出神。
周围人来人往，旅者匆匆，并不会有人会注意到这个坐在椅子上发呆的年轻人。
其实，今天上午的时候，陈言刚从公司辞职——嗯，也不对。
准确的说，是没熬过实习期，就提桶走人了。
今年毕业季的秋招情况格外残酷，所以这份工作虽然干活比牛马多，薪水比鸡食少，但是在几个月前，刚毕业的陈言还是无奈接受这份工作。
实习期三个月，薪水拿一半。
没想到，忍受了三个月的牲口生涯，每天帮部门领导取快递拿外卖并客串提包小弟，经常性的加班熬夜，还要偶尔在部门里工作出篓子时候负责客串【背锅的实习生】，结果却发现这个领导压根不是人。
好吧，在如今这个职场里，好像就没有几个算是人的领导嘛。
事情是这样的，今天早上陈言在公司里刚下楼帮领导买了咖啡——老女人为了省几块钱的外卖费，经常指派他人肉去买。
回到办公室前，陈言就接到老家村里的人打来电话，说陈言的奶奶生病了，如果方便的话，让陈言能回去瞧瞧。
陈言找领导请假的时候，那个老女人一边喝着陈言帮她买回来的冰美式，一边不耐烦的说了一句：哟，怎么早不病晚不病，偏在月底最忙的时候就病了？
一句话，让已经忍了三个月当牛做马的生活，已经陪了三个月笑脸的陈言，直接爆发了。
那杯他亲手帮老女人买回来的外卖咖啡，当场被他夺过来，直接泼在了这个老女人的脑袋上！
然后，陈言掉头走出办公室回到自己工位。
老女人追出办公室，在办公室里十几个同事众目睽睽下，对陈言破口大骂。
众目睽睽之下，陈言忽然转身，脸上露出年轻人羞涩而温和的笑容，不怒不火，彬彬有礼的回了两句话。
“阿曼达，我真的不喜欢比我大十几岁的女人，所以就算你答应给我升职，我也真的不能接受你，实在对不起哈~~”
这两句话说出来，部门里十多个同事当场就眼睛发光，瞬间化身吃瓜群众，
一时间看着这个眉清目秀的年轻实习生，再看看已经三十八岁的中年少女阿曼达……一个个的，嘴巴和眼睛都瞪得圆溜溜，内心里狂呼卧槽！

诶诶诶！
听说阿曼达她老公可就是分公司的副总啊！
卧槽，这女人胆子可肥啊！
其中几位公司的八卦界风云人士，当场脑子里都想好了，这个瓜要和谁去分享了！
老女人气急跳脚，刚说一句：你胡说八道污蔑……
陈言已经微笑着鞠了躬，然后提包撒腿就跑，出了公司直接叫了个网约车，直奔高铁站。
……
算不上什么零零后整顿职场，无非就是一个被欺负到不想再忍的少年郎罢了。
此刻坐在高铁站的候车大厅里，陈言脑子里已经压根在乎公司的狗屁事儿，至于那个叫阿曼达的中年仙女，更是去想了。
不行……听我家老太太的话，就回乡去，继承她的衣钵？
家乡的奶奶，陈言称之为【我家老太太】的那位老人，养了陈言二十年，从他两岁开始。
准确的说，陈言是被老太太捡来的。
怎么捡来的，从哪里捡来的，老太太这么多年都没说清楚。
嗯，其实是版本太多，而老太太自己又总是吃设定啊！
六岁的时候，陈言问起来的时候，老太太说是从县医院的妇产科外面垃圾桶捡到的陈言。
八岁的时候，老太太的说法是，她有次去山上的破庙，在庙后面的大树下发现的陈言。
十一岁的时候，老太太的说法又变成，在一个风雪交加的夜晚，一个年轻漂亮走投无路的女人，抱着襁褓中的陈言，哀求到了老太太的门前，丢下了孩子和二百块钱就走掉了。
十五岁的时候，老太太改口说，其实陈言是她从人贩子手里救回来的。
十八岁……
好吧，十八岁时候说的版本最神奇：

老太太说是在一个风雪交加的夜晚，一个漂亮年轻走投无路的女人，抱着襁褓中的陈言哀求到了老太太的门前……

Chapter 1 [What, my mother is a white fox? 】
Chen Yan was sitting in the waiting hall of Jinlingfu High-speed Railway Station, holding a backpack in his hand and looking at the billboards in the waiting hall in trance.
There were people coming and going around and travelers in a hurry, but no one would notice this young man sitting in a chair in a daze.
In fact, this morning, Chen Yan had just resigned from the company - well, that wasn't right either.
To be precise, I just picked up the bucket and left before I got through the internship period.
The autumn recruitment situation during this year's graduation season is particularly cruel, so although this job requires more work than cattle and horses, and the salary is less than chicken food, Chen Yan, who just graduated a few months ago, still had no choice but to accept this job.
The internship period is three months and you get half salary.
Unexpectedly, after enduring three months of working as a working animal, helping the department leader pick up express delivery and takeout food every day and acting as a baggage boy, often working overtime and staying up late, and occasionally being the "intern taking the blame" when things go wrong in the department, it turns out that this leader is not a human being at all.
Well, in today’s workplace, there seem to be few leaders who can be considered human beings.
What happened was this morning, Chen Yan just went downstairs to buy coffee for his boss at the company - the old woman often assigned others to buy coffee in order to save a few dollars on takeaway fees.
Before returning to the office, Chen Yan received a call from someone in his hometown village, saying that Chen Yan's grandma was sick. If it was convenient, Chen Yan could go back and take a look.
When Chen Yan asked for leave from his boss, the old woman said impatiently while drinking the iced American that Chen Yan bought for her: Oh, how come you don't get sick early and don't get sick later, but you get sick at the busiest time at the end of the month?
With one sentence, Chen Yan, who had endured the life of being a cow and a horse for three months, and had been accompanied by a smiling face for three months, immediately exploded.
The cup of takeaway coffee he bought for the old woman with his own hands was snatched away by him on the spot and poured directly on the old woman's head!
Then, Chen Yan turned around and walked out of the office and returned to his workstation.
The old woman chased him out of the office and cursed Chen Yan in full view of more than a dozen colleagues in the office.
In full view of everyone, Chen Yan suddenly turned around, with a shy and gentle smile of a young man on his face. He was neither angry nor angry, and replied politely.
"Amanda, I really don't like women who are more than ten years older than me, so even if you promise to give me a promotion, I really can't accept you. I'm really sorry~~"
After saying these two sentences, the eyes of more than a dozen colleagues in the department lit up on the spot, and they instantly transformed into people eating melons.
For a moment, I looked at this young intern with delicate features, and then at the thirty-eight-year-old middle-aged girl Amanda... Each of them, their mouths and eyes were wide open, and they were screaming in their hearts, "Fuck!"
Hey, hey, hey!
I heard that Amanda’s husband is the vice president of the branch!
Damn it, this woman is so brave!
Several of the company's most influential people in the gossip industry had already thought about who they were going to share this melon with on the spot!
The old woman jumped up and down in anger, and just said: You are talking nonsense and slandering...
Chen Yan had already bowed with a smile, then ran away with his bag. After leaving the company, he directly called an online taxi and went straight to the high-speed rail station.
…
It's not a post-00s job to reorganize the workplace, it's just a young man who was bullied to the point where he couldn't stand it anymore.
Sitting in the waiting hall of the high-speed rail station, Chen Yan was already thinking about the company's bullshit, and even more so about the middle-aged fairy named Amanda.
No... just listen to my old lady and go back to your hometown to inherit her mantle?
The grandmother in his hometown, whom Chen Yan calls "my old lady", has raised Chen Yan for twenty years, since he was two years old.
To be precise, Chen Yan was picked up by the old lady.
How and where it was picked up, the old lady has not been able to tell clearly for so many years.
Well, actually there are too many versions, and the old ladyI always eat settings!
When Chen Yan asked about it when he was six years old, the old lady said she picked it up from the trash can outside the obstetrics and gynecology department of the county hospital.
When she was eight years old, the old lady said that she once went to a ruined temple on the mountain and found Chen Yan under the big tree behind the temple.
When she was eleven years old, the old lady's story changed. On a snowy night, a young and beautiful desperate woman came to the old lady's door with her infant Chen Yan in her arms, left her child and two hundred yuan, and walked away.
When she was fifteen years old, the old lady changed her story and said that she actually rescued Chen Yan from human traffickers.
Eighteen years old...
Well, the version I said when I was eighteen is the most amazing:
The old lady said that on a snowy night, a beautiful young desperate woman came to the old lady's door holding her infant Chen Yan and begging...
